scope: Instrumented isolated application candidate on the pinned rotated Split fixture; no native runtime instrumentation
method: Copy the isolated candidate, add observation-only events recording whether experimental point ordering is enabled and when its directed-edge safety fallback is invoked, then run the existing oracle-directed facet diagnostic.
events: The first source face enabled experimental ordering and processed eight segments.
The second source face enabled experimental ordering and processed nine segments, then triggered the directed-edge safety fallback.
The fallback reprocessed that second face without experimental ordering.
interpretation: The remaining four post-oracle facet differences lie in the second source face, where the candidate fell back. This is a reason to investigate its cavity topology, not a reason to disable the safety check.
limitations: The fallback is application behavior, not observed native behavior.
